task: Create a box and a sphere, then fuse them into a single shape.
macro:
import FreeCAD
import Part
doc = FreeCAD.newDocument("T")
box = doc.addObject("Part::Box", "Box")
box.Length = 10
box.Width = 10
box.Height = 10
sphere = doc.addObject("Part::Sphere", "Sphere")
sphere.Radius = 8
sphere.Placement.Base = FreeCAD.Vector(5, 5, 5)
fuse = doc.addObject("Part::MultiFuse", "Fusion")
fuse.Shapes = [box, sphere]
doc.recompute()

task: Create a PartDesign Body with a 10x10x5 pad, then pocket a 5x5 square through all.
macro:
import FreeCAD
import Sketcher
import PartDesign
doc = FreeCAD.newDocument("T")
body = doc.addObject("PartDesign::Body", "Body")
sketch1 = doc.addObject("Sketcher::SketchObject", "Sketch1")
body.addObject(sketch1)
geom1 = [Part.LineSegment(FreeCAD.Vector(0,0,0), FreeCAD.Vector(10,0,0)),
         Part.LineSegment(FreeCAD.Vector(10,0,0), FreeCAD.Vector(10,10,0)),
         Part.LineSegment(FreeCAD.Vector(10,10,0), FreeCAD.Vector(0,10,0)),
         Part.LineSegment(FreeCAD.Vector(0,10,0), FreeCAD.Vector(0,0,0))]
for g in geom1:
    sketch1.addGeometry(g, False)
pad = doc.addObject("PartDesign::Pad", "Pad")
pad.Sketch = sketch1
pad.Length = 5.0
body.addObject(pad)
sketch2 = doc.addObject("Sketcher::SketchObject", "Sketch2")
body.addObject(sketch2)
geom2 = [Part.LineSegment(FreeCAD.Vector(2.5,2.5,0), FreeCAD.Vector(7.5,2.5,0)),
         Part.LineSegment(FreeCAD.Vector(7.5,2.5,0), FreeCAD.Vector(7.5,7.5,0)),
         Part.LineSegment(FreeCAD.Vector(7.5,7.5,0), FreeCAD.Vector(2.5,7.5,0)),
         Part.LineSegment(FreeCAD.Vector(2.5,7.5,0), FreeCAD.Vector(2.5,2.5,0))]
for g in geom2:
    sketch2.addGeometry(g, False)
pocket = doc.addObject("PartDesign::Pocket", "Pocket")
pocket.Sketch = sketch2
pocket.Type = "ThroughAll"
doc.recompute()

task: Create a 10x10x10 box and apply a fillet of radius 2 to one edge.
macro:
import FreeCAD
import Part
doc = FreeCAD.newDocument("T")
box = doc.addObject("Part::Box", "Box")
box.Length = 10
box.Width = 10
box.Height = 10
fillet = doc.addObject("Part::Fillet", "Fillet")
fillet.Base = box
fillet.Radius = 2.0
fillet.Edges = [(box, ["Edge1"])]
doc.recompute()

task: Create a spreadsheet with an alias 'width' set to 5, then use it in an expression for a box's Width.
macro:
import FreeCAD
import Spreadsheet
doc = FreeCAD.newDocument("T")
ss = doc.addObject("Spreadsheet::Sheet", "SS")
ss.set("A1", "5")
ss.setAlias("B1", "width")
box = doc.addObject("Part::Box", "Box")
box.setExpression("Width", u"SS.width")
doc.recompute()

task: Create a cylinder and rotate it 45 degrees about the Z-axis.
macro:
import FreeCAD
import Part
doc = FreeCAD.newDocument("T")
cyl = doc.addObject("Part::Cylinder", "Cylinder")
cyl.Radius = 5
cyl.Height = 10
cyl.Placement = FreeCAD.Placement(FreeCAD.Vector(0,0,0), FreeCAD.Rotation(FreeCAD.Vector(0,0,1), 45))
doc.recompute()
